description: List the team's AI UGC videos, newest first, each with its status, its videos and their links, a page at a time: a page's next, where it has one, sent as after answers the page after it. Product videos and image ads are not listed; each is read by its id with get_product_video or get_image_ads. Each ready video's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_video again for a new link. Free.

after.description: The next value the page before answered, for the page after it.

limit.description: How many videos to list. 20 by default.

name: list_videos
title: Videos
